items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: worked in a swing sextet with Ruby Braff and Marshall Brown

ctx.x: Saxophonist Tommy Newsom was born in Portsmouth, Virginia in 1929. his musical education was first in the classical field as a clarinetist. After his studies at Peabody he was able to employ his saxophone and arranging skills with the Air Force Band and later in the studios of New York City. He toured with Benny Goodman and worked in a swing sextet with Ruby Braff and Marshall Brown. In 1962 Tommy joined the NBC music staff and became lead alto for the Tonight Show Band. He eventually became Assistant Conductor…

Ross Tompkins is a Detroit native who studied piano at the New England Conservatory. From 1960-67 he freelanced in New York, performing with Clark Terry, Kai Winding, Herb Ellis and other major artists. He joined his friend Tommy Newsom in the Tonight Show Band and held down the piano chair for the duration, also performing with the Louis Bellson Big Band in Los Angeles. He records frequently as a sideman and as a solo pianist.
